root_cause: Exact root cause unproven: original production Netlify route swallowed all provider exceptions and emitted generic 502, so the original agent could not tell if model output, billing, authorization or governance was responsible.
fix: Log strict machine-safe allowlist classification, not raw error or question, while preserving original user-facing 502 and privacy guarantees. Then reproduce and independently read Netlify request logs before implementing semantic fix.
prevention_rule: Each original provider failure must expose only a redacted root failure class in original controlled telemetry. No HTTP 200 or GREEN without provider output proof; no original data/secret logging or parallel executor.
terminal_rule: Require protected Required/CodeQL/BRAIN, original Netlify production deploy, live request log showing exact source failure taxonomy, owner RCA, provider successful response and no recurring incident.

verification_update_20261103.reason: Original Netlify per-request observability does not expose server console logs in connected API; allowlisted error category needs independent response header readback.
verification_update_20261103.next_safe_fix: Add X-BG-Recovery-Class header with only allowlisted machine class to original generic 502; repeat original public question; keep safe response body, no prompt/secret/PII.
